questionRules.R8R-AUTHORITY: PRESERVED: exact current735/113 authority supersedes Conference01's525/323. questionRules.R8R-DIVINE-ACTION: NEW interpretation of printed6th-level/Tier6: maximum ordinary generating rank6 under the selected actual catalog class-access row, not character level. Preserve the outer Action/21RP/120feet/V/S/F. After its successful resolution invoke exactly one eligible child spell with its normal Action or Bonus Action requirement waived; no extra Action, Bonus Action, Reaction or turn is added to anyone's budget. This child is an actual separately paid cast, not an automatic copy. Reaction-only, passive and long-ritual modes are outside this newly bounded immediate invocation contract; their unanswered trigger/preparation requirements remain held, not silently converted. Ordinary duration/concentration payloads are allowed.
questionRules.R8R-DIVINE-PAYLOAD: NEW invocation profile DI169 is a nonautonomous spell-generated conduit, not a deity creature, actor, class engine or proof of divine identity. Its source-character, payer, owner, concentration bearer and damage dealer are the invoker. Use the invoker's actual outer casting ability, PB and granting-class level for child intrinsic scaling; no deity statistics or borrowed class features. The finite positive invocation catalog is explicitly listed in INVOCATION_CATALOG.json: Armor of Faith, Protection from Scrying, Wall of Force, Planar Barrier, Antimagic Field Lesser, Dispel Magic, Mending and Faction Divination, with each exact operative source and eligible native row. This NEW bounded repertoire is wider than the invoker's own known/prepared spells and can include another class's row; it waives learned/prepared/list acquisition only for this one child, never independent material/body/target/ownership/frequency prerequisites. All other rank≤6 cards remain source-qualified extension candidates, not silently operational invocation choices. The scope is eight complete payload identities, not all possible catalog spells. Choose a perceived conduit point within120 feet/line of effect at resolution; non-Self child range and originating line of effect measure from it, but required target perception still belongs to the actual invoker. Self/touch/body-origin children require the conduit at the invoker's real body and use its actual touch/body. No remote vision, independent body or remote Self beneficiary is created.
questionRules.R8R-DIVINE-COSTS: NEW: pay outer21RP plus its real surcharge; pay the selected native child base RP, printed additions, current surcharge, actual consumed materials and other prerequisites once. Only child Action/Bonus Action time is waived. Invoker performs each child's components with real hands/focus/custody. Reserve the known complete prospective bill before committing the parent, including deterministic chronological strain/hooks; no known unaffordable nested cast. Parent counter consumes only parent costs and releases the unspent child reservation. Child revalidation uses current resources after intervening reactions. Outer normal Wizard prepared-family rule applies. Invoked child is not a prepared Wizard matrix under this route: it receives no first-prepared-family base exemption or matrix/school/class cast-trigger benefit, but normal base Dissonance, Refrain, surcharge and broadly applicable constraints apply. Child DC=8+invokerPB+outerability, without borrowed school mastery; intrinsic spell scaling uses actual outer granting-class level. This is an explicit local adapter, not an amendment to ordinary prepared casting. A concentrating child replaces incompatible current concentration at its own commitment; a later counter does not restore it. Child effects retain their own real generating rank, clocks, source ownership and dispel/defense scope.
questionRules.R8R-DIVINE-ORDER: NEW finite transaction: declare child identity/mode/native row before parent; validate and reserve projected costs; commit parent and its ordinary casting history/components; resolve parent counter window; on successful resolution create one single-use immediate entitlement, select/revalidate conduit and child targets/current prerequisites; consume entitlement before child commitment; pay/perform child, establish concentration and update chronological history; resolve child's own counter window; resolve child. A failed revalidation ends the entitlement with no child payment, parent refund or alternate child choice. Source/controller changes do not transfer it. Resuming a parent after a reaction never replays parent history. Wizard Counterspell targets the perceived actual invoker performing components, within its real60feet,3RP,rank1,INT+PB against10+2×triggering rank,recharge2; the noncreature conduit is not a new target. Record parent/child/nonces and roots distinctly. A resolved, failed, countered or expired entitlement cannot bank, replay, trigger on load or be invoked again.
questionRules.R8R-DIVINE-RECURSION: NEW lineage ceiling is one invoked child. The explicit eight-identity catalog produces no child invocations/copies/action grants. Echo Cast and Arcane Echo are deliberately ineligible cast-generation mechanisms; a name merely containing echo is not the criterion. Rank7 Fate Echo and rank8 Divine Intervention Lesser fail the native rank≤6 gate independently. No duration ban: Wall of Force, Planar Barrier and real wards persist normally. An external cast/copy hook cannot use this invocation child to generate a further descendant cast or additional action-grant chain; the parent remains an ordinary outer spell under its own real source. Generic Ready may prepare the outer Action spell: choose child/mode/row and pay parent once at preparation, held under concentration until next own regular START, with the parent counter window then. Select/revalidate conduit and child target on release after the actual trigger; release spends Reaction, not another parent Action/RP/strain. The child then receives its own commitment/counter window as above. Failed/declined invalid Ready occurrence spends no release Reaction and can wait until expiry; release consumes the Ready. Expiry or lost concentration loses the parent costs and creates no child. This local child rule never moves Ready before its trigger.
